from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class Paper(BaseModel):
    """One provided paper and its citation relationship to other papers in the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of this paper")
    cites_provided_papers: list[str] = Field(description="Titles of OTHER provided papers that this paper explicitly cites in its reference list")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    papers: list[Paper]
